title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: blockingflow
text:
blocking flow
blocking flow
(definition)
Definition:
A
flow function
in which any directed
path
from the
source
to the
sink
contains a
saturated edge
.
See also
flow network
.
